#   type: "state"

#   dictionary: 8 lowercase hex   vocabulary id, must match gui/catalog.json
#   boot: 16 lowercase hex        coach boot id
#   configured, radio, busy: 0|1  provisioning flag, radio flag, call busy flag
#   seq: uint32                   last call sequence, 0 when idle
#   category: 0|1|2               0 none, 1 pitch, 2 play
#   code: uint32                  0 when seq is 0, else 1..171 pitch or 1..21 play
#   links: 5 x 0|1                  per unit index, in unit order
#   delivery: 5 x 0..4               per unit: 0 none, 1 waiting, 2 accepted, 3 unconfirmed, 4 error
#                                 index 0 is the coach and always 0
#   records: 2 records            index 0 pitch category, index 1 play category
#     category: 1|2               fixed by index
#     seq: uint32                 retained call sequence, 0 when none
#     code: uint32                0 when seq is 0, else 1..171 or 1..21
#     delivery: 5 x 0..4             per unit index, in unit order; index 0 is always 0
#   Coach frames (role 0) keep records consistent with the current call: a record
#   seq is never newer than seq, and the record matching category repeats seq,
#   code, and its delivery array.
#
# result frame fields:
#   type: "result"
#   v: 4                          USB protocol version
#   client: 8 lowercase hex       GUI client that sent the request

#   id: uint32 >= 1               request id from the call command
#   result: 0..5                  0 accepted, 1 busy, 2 offline, 3 rejected, 4 expired, 5 session changed
#   seq: uint32                   assigned call sequence, nonzero only when result is 0
